title: ID0478892-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / R5 1700019271] There is no any logs on the SCB
description:
Reported behavior/issue: Configuration issue
Solution: In data/sicharge-cp-backend/config/device.cer must be device.crt

additional_info.subject: Error Description
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
We previously opened ticket ID0459018 regarding the issue described below. Although we were informed that the ticket would be forwarded to the Champions Team, it was closed without a resolution.
Since the issue still persists, we are opening a new ticket and kindly request your support.
The device has just been commissioned. However, it does not appear as “Online” in the SCB.
Details of the issue:
Error messages are visible under “Error Flags.”
No records appear under “Show Logs.”
All device LEDs are green.
The device is online and operational in the customer’s OCPP system.
The issue seems to be limited to the SCB side.
We kindly ask for your support to investigate and resolve this matter.
Looking forward to your feedback.
